name: 现摘现发软甜多汁皇冠梨款
description: 皮薄多汁、果肉洁白细腻、清脆香甜，现摘现发含炖梨食谱场景

styleLock.direction: fresh fruit e-commerce, appetizing and clean
styleLock.backgroundSystem: soft sky-blue panels #C5E6F2/#E4F4FB for hero and archive screens, warm apricot #F5DCAD for growing-story and CTA screens, grey-blue stone #A2ACBB for detail insets, white-washed wood #EDE7DD for flat lays
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused light with a gentle top light and soft contact shadows; natural bloom on fruit skin, glistening juicy flesh, never plastic-looking
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte grey-blue stone slab #A2ACBB, white-washed wood planks #EDE7DD, light bamboo wicker
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep teal-blue #256E8C only, labels 10-14pt, with one fresh leaf-green accent #7FA75A reserved for small badges, thin-line icons and dividers
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single leaf-green #7FA75A accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for whole fruit with stem, halved fruit always shows the cut face toward camera; consistent fruit scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh-fruit e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, soft sky-blue #C5E6F2, warm apricot #F5DCAD, deep teal-blue text #256E8C and one fresh leaf-green accent #7FA75A for badges and icons; bright soft diffused lighting with a gentle top light and soft contact shadows, natural bloom on the fruit skin and glistening juicy flesh, never plastic-looking; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep teal-blue only; consistent rounded rectangle and pill-shaped info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean appetizing fruit photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 一秒传递软甜多汁的核心利益，赢得点击
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level view, one whole fruit with stem upright on the right and one halved fruit leaning in the lower left showing the cut face
shots.lighting: bright soft diffused daylight from the upper left with gentle top fill, soft contact shadow under the fruit
shots.background: soft sky-blue gradient panel #C5E6F2 fading down to #EAF6FC
shots.props: two or three fresh green leaves
shots.textZone: upper-left area with a headline 「{callout_1}」 in #256E8C, a sub-line 「{selling_point_1}」 and one small pill label 「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One whole fruit with its stem upright on the right and one halved fruit leaning in the lower left, cut face toward camera, photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level view. Bright soft diffused daylight from the upper left with gentle top fill, soft contact shadow, juicy natural flesh texture. Background a soft sky-blue gradient panel #C5E6F2 fading down to #EAF6FC, two or three fresh green leaves as props tucked behind the fruit. The fruit group anchors the lower two thirds of the frame and occupies 60-70% of the frame, the upper-left corner completing the composition with a headline 「{callout_1}」 in #256E8C, a sub-line 「{selling_point_1}」 and one small pill label 「{callout_2}」. 8K commercial fresh-produce quality. Negative: no watermark, no fake logo, no dense body text, no more than one main claim, no plastic-looking waxy fruit, no invented sugar content or origin names, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 从 9 张皇冠梨爆款详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源图文案、产地信息（地名/规格/地标宣称）、会员二维码与装饰元素；产品一律以 {product} 占位，无法核实的证据类信息一律不在图中呈现，由使用方按实际资质补充；品类按 taxonomy 判定为 生鲜粮油/水果。
